tools.description:
Search memory using a natural language query. The query text is sent to
    Eve's servers to perform the search.

    Args:
        query: The natural language question or keywords
        source_agent: Agent/tool calling this API (audit trail).
        limit: Max number of results (default 10)
        min_similarity: Minimum confidence threshold (0.0-1.0)
        store: Memory store to search — "semantic" (default),
               "episodic", "learned_rules", "preference", or "all"
            Routing guidance:
            - use "preference" only for explicitly stored user,
              workflow/operating, behavior, or taste preferences such as:
              "which model do I prefer", "what tone do I like",
              "what is my code quality bar", "which blues artists do I like",
              or "what kind of feedback do I prefer"
            - keep "semantic" for durable facts, project or team decisions,
              architecture choices, and relationship lookup, even if the query
              uses words like "prefer" or "favorite" (for example, "which
              database do we prefer for this service")
            - use "episodic" for event, session, and history recall
            - questions that ask the system to infer a preference that may not
              be explicitly stored should not be auto-routed to "preference"
            - use "all" only for broad recall when you intentionally want
              multiple memory stores to participate
        merge_policy: Cross-store merge policy when store="all":
            interleave, weighted_rrf, or calibrated_fusion.
        context: Context scope (personal, naya, es). The default is "all";
            both omitting context and explicitly passing "all" broaden search
            across contexts. Use an explicit context such as "personal" to
            constrain preference scope when calling "preference".
        visibility: Visibility scope ("PERSONAL" or "SHARED"). Omitted visibility
            defaults to PERSONAL. In active team tenant contexts, omitted visibility
            fans out across own PERSONAL and team SHARED results only when
            TEAM_SEARCH_FANOUT_ENABLED=true. Explicit PERSONAL or SHARED remains
            single-scope.
        category: Filter by memory category (e.g. "architecture",
            "security"). Use "all" or omit to search all categories.
tools.name: memory_search

tools.description:
Records a session-end log on Eve's servers, including a summary of the
    session. Stored until deleted; viewable and deletable in your Eve
    workspace at evemem.com/app.

    Automatically triggers the AI learning and reflexion pipeline.

    Args:
        summary: Brief description of the outcome (success/failure)
        source_agent: Agent/tool calling this API (audit trail). Default "unknown".
        session_id: Optional UUID matching the session_start
        context: Context scope (personal, naya, es) — default "personal"
        details: Optional dictionary of context
        status: Session outcome — "success", "failure", or "unknown" (optional)
tools.name: memory_session_end

tools.description:
Sends transcript text to Eve's servers, where a third-party AI model
    (Google Gemini) extracts facts, preferences, and events. The transcript
    and the extracted memories are stored on Eve's servers. Stored data is
    viewable in your Eve workspace at evemem.com/app; conversation records
    can be deleted there, and semantic memories with the memory_forget tool.

    Optionally auto-stores extracted items with dedup checking.

    Args:
        transcript: Raw transcript text to extract memories from
        source: Source identifier (e.g., claude_code, gemini_cli)
        source_agent: Agent/tool calling this API (audit trail). Default "unknown".
        session_id: Optional session UUID for provenance tracking
        auto_store: If true, automatically store extracted items (with dedup)
        context: Context scope (personal, naya, es) -- default "personal"
        min_importance: Only extract items at or above this importance (1-10, default 4)
        use_extraction: If true, use atomic fact extraction
            (produces SPO fields) instead of classifier
tools.name: memory_extract

tools.description:
Sends the raw conversation to Eve's servers before context compaction,
    where a third-party AI model (Google Gemini) distills it into memories.
    The conversation content and the resulting memories are stored on Eve's
    servers. Stored data is viewable in your Eve workspace at evemem.com/app;
    conversation records can be deleted there, and semantic memories with the
    memory_forget tool. Applies per-session (max 3) and per-agent-hour
    (max 30) rate limits. Skips if the same session+content hash was already
    processed.

    Args:
        session_id: Current session UUID
        messages: List of {role, content} dicts (user/assistant/system)
        source_agent: Agent/tool calling this API (audit trail). Default "unknown".
        context: Context scope (personal, naya, es) — default "personal"
tools.name: memory_pre_compact
